# Zekun Wang

Zekun Wang builds AI agents, evaluation systems, browser-based AI, and local-first developer tools.

This is Zekun Wang’s personal blog. Unless explicitly stated otherwise, the projects and opinions published here are independent of his work at Indeed.

## Main topics

- AI agents and coding agents
- LLM evaluation
- Agent memory
- Browser-based AI
- Local-first software
- Developer tools
